draft.subject: Subject: Update: Replacement Vehicle Dispatched for Orion Pharma Shipment
draft.body:
Subject: Update: Replacement Vehicle Dispatched for Orion Pharma Shipment

Dear Orion Pharma Team,

Following a mechanical breakdown of vehicle UK79WJ9666, a replacement unit (UK81YH8800) has been dispatched from the Rudrapur hub. The new vehicle is currently en route to Kanpur with an estimated arrival time of approximately 9.5 hours. We are monitoring the journey closely to ensure timely delivery and will provide further updates as needed.

Best regards,
Meridian Freight Dispatch
